title: /integrations/tautulli
description: Instructions on how to set up Tautulli sensors in Home Assistant.
body:
The **Tautulli**  will monitor activity on a given [Tautulli Server][tautulli]. It will create a sensor that shows the number of currently active streams as the state. If you click the sensor for more details, it will show you more statistics.

## Setup

To find your `api_key`, open the Tautulli web interface and navigate to `Settings` and then to `Web interface`. The `api_key` will be at the bottom of that page.

The following stats are available by default:

- LAN bandwidth
- Number of direct plays
- Number of direct streams
- Stream count
- Top Movie
- Top TV Show
- Top User
- Total bandwidth
- Transcode count
- WAN bandwidth

[tautulli]: https://tautulli.com
